equipment_type: Laboratory room airflow and pressure controller
applies_to: TSI LRC modular laboratory room controllers handling up to 6 supplies, 2 general exhausts and 20 fume hoods.
summary: The TSI LRC controls a lab room by tracking supply, general exhaust and fume hood flows to hold an airflow offset and room pressure, with per-supply temperature control. Its BACnet object set is almost entirely Analog, Binary and Multi-state Values: setup values (flow ranges, setpoints, alarm limits, sensor calibration) plus live flows, temperatures, room pressure and alarm states. The list is long because every supply, exhaust and hood channel has its own block.
notes: Taken from the BACnet Object Set appendix (manual pages 110-149). TSI states every object is readable and writable; objects TSI marks "DO NOT OVERWRITE" are listed here as read-only.
Units are from the LRC00 column (CFM, in. W.C., °F). The LRC00-LPS and LRC00-CMH versions use LPS or CMH for flow, Pa for pressure, m² for area and °C for temperature.
Rows printed as "Not applicable" (16 reserved objects) are left out. Some instance numbers are skipped in the table (for example AV 109, AV 380-383, AV 637-652).
A few names are printed out of sequence in the table (for example AV 17 "Supply 5 Flow Error" inside the Supply 1 block) and are kept as printed.
Binary and multi-state state texts printed once for a group of rows are applied to every row in that group.

source.title: Laboratory Room Controller Model LRC Operation and Service Manual

integration.summary: Read room pressure, total supply and exhaust flow, the controller flow mode and the alarm status MVs. The BMS can set occupancy per supply (BV 24-27), trigger emergency or shutdown mode (BV 22/23) and change the room pressure setpoint (AV 268). TSI suggests picking only the points you need instead of auto-discovering the whole set.

minimum_points.name: Current Supply 1 Flow Alarm Status
minimum_points.why: Supply 1 flow: 1 = normal, 2 = low, 3 = high alarm

integration.enable: No separate BMS enable is described. Occupancy per supply (BV 24-27, BV 297/298 for supplies 5-6), Emergency Mode (BV 22) and Shutdown Mode (BV 23) are writable and switch the controller between its occupied, unoccupied, emergency and shutdown flow setpoints.
setup: BACnet MS/TP runs at 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 baud; the end-of-line resistors on the LRC00 are DIP switches, off by default.

BACnet IP uses the two RJ-45 ports. TSI says the Ethernet IP is dynamic (DHCP) by default, but a new controller loaded with its initial file comes up at static 192.168.200.90 (set a laptop to 192.168.200.1 to reach it); change it in the controller web interface.
The PICS lists the LRC as a BACnet Building Controller (B-BC).
gotchas: TSI warns that writing values can upset room control; leave objects marked DO NOT OVERWRITE (live readings, calibration and calculated values) alone.
Most objects are commissioning settings (flow ranges, K-factors, calibration, PID tuning); do not write them cyclically.
Auto-discovery of the full object set takes a long time; map only the points you need.
Units differ between the LRC00, LRC00-LPS and LRC00-CMH versions.
